messages:
maya: Hey team — PR #2387 (migration guide for Private deployments) is ready for merge when reviewers sign off. Docs preview: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-2387. @jonah can you do a quick tech skim? @sara for style. Heads up: docs CI linkcheck + vale failed on the preview, so we can't merge yet.

ci-bot: CI report for PR #2387 — 2 failing checks: linkcheck, vale. Re-run with `/retest` in comments.

maya: Copying the failing output so it's easier to triage:
```
LINKCHECK FAIL: /docs/private/deployments.md -> broken link: https://old-partner.example.com/setup (404)
VALE FAIL: docs/private/deployments.md:45 – 'Redwood' flagged for 'capitals' rule (expect 'Redwood' but found 'redwood')
SPELLCHECK WARNING: 'onprem' might be 'on-prem' or 'on premise'
```

jonah: I'll take the link. Looks like we pointed to an external partner doc that moved. Suggest replace with our migration snippet + internal KB link.

sara: I'll fix the Vale/style things — standardize to 'Redwood' and change 'onprem' -> 'on-prem'. Also drop passive voice in the first paragraph. Small copy changes, shouldn't affect the preview build much.

maya: Thanks. Two questions: 1) If I push fixes, will the docs preview rebuild automatically? 2) We normally wait for the midday deploy window — can we merge later today?

docs-bot: Pull request updated — new commit 3f2a1b5 pushed. Docs preview rebuilt: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-2387 (build queued).

dave: FYI: We prefer to merge low-risk docs changes outside the release freeze if they don't touch the SDK snippets that are pinned. This one only touches docs and an external link — ok to merge after CI green and at 1pm PT merge window.

ci-bot: Docs preview completed — linkcheck PASS, spellcheck PASS, vale FAIL (1 rule).

maya: Copy of the failing vale message: `docs/private/deployments.md:78 – VALE[Clarity] too wordy: simplify this sentence.` Sara, is that the passive voice you mentioned?

sara: Yep — line 78 is where I recommended rewording. I'll push a short edit now.

docs-bot: Pull request updated — new commit f7a9c2d. Preview rebuild triggered: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-2387 (build passed).

maya: All green. @jonah and @dave — can we merge at 13:00 PT? If there's no objection I'll squash-merge then. :thumbsup:

jonah: LGTM — tech LGTM. No functional changes. :shipit:

dave: Fine by me. Please include the KB link replacement in the PR description so support can reference it.

maya: Will do — PR description updated with KB link and brief rationale. Merging at 13:00 PT. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :raised_hands:
